study.name: H11: 256px PV Diagnostic — Text Baseline
study.description:
Single deterministic text-only proposer pass (T=0.0) on the full 256px
evaluation area (1032 tiles, calibration areas excluded). Fed through
PV verifier. Smoke test — if N=1 + PV F1 < 0.75, the 256px pathway
is unlikely to beat 384px best (F1=0.883) and we stop.
